checkout_rails: No native checkout flow on StyleAI's product; checkout occurs on retailer's e-commerce stack; integration via catalog feed and payment gateway.
value.expectation_copy: First-time visitors are greeted with a value proposition centered on AI-driven fashion styling (StyleAI) and brand-consistent recommendations, e.g., "AI That Sells The Way You Would" and "Fashion-Native AI Agents". Copy should emphasize measurable ROI, easy deployment, and brand-safe, privacy-first design. For OnPoint, adapt this to highlight fit-aware stock, real stock verification, and local pay rails (e.g., mobile payments in Africa) within a supply graph that connects fashion curators to shoppers.
value.gap_vs_onpoint: Gaps to address: StyleAI focuses on AI-driven styling, brand personalization, and an agentic commerce layer for catalog-based retailers; it does not provide a West/East Africa–specific supply graph or local-monetary rails. OnPoint should copy and adapt: (1) an explicit African-curated supply graph with vetted fit-ready stock, (2) native local payment integration (WhatsApp/M-Pesa) and agent-based procurement, (3) a concrete, production-ready checkout flow that ties inventory to local partners, and (4) a clear articulation of how AI styling ties to real-stock fulfillment in Nairobi/Lagos/Accra.
value.pricing_tiers: Public enterprise pricing for StyleAI is not openly listed; industry context cites $50,000–$200,000/yr for enterprise styling solutions; StyleAI.art (consumer-oriented) shows Free and paid tiers (Mini/Plus/Pro/Max) for image/creative tools. For OnPoint, propose tiers tied to catalog size, stock-availability, and activation of local-pay rails.
value.product: AI commerce platform for fashion retailers that transforms catalogs into Fashion-Native AI Agents with brand-specific styling logic, real-time analytics, and deployment tooling; designed for reliable, privacy-first, production-grade experiences and human-in-the-loop control.
